svg.title: Investment Analytics Medallion: Three Ingestion Paths to Direct Lake
svg.desc: An architecture diagram with three ingestion paths on the left — file Copy, database Mirroring, and API pulls — all landing in one lakehouse that holds both bronze and silver schemas. A dbt project, orchestrated by Airflow inside Data Factory, reads silver and builds a star schema in a Fabric Warehouse as gold. Power BI reads gold through Direct Lake with no refresh. Two side rails run underneath: a SQL database control plane recording every run, and an Eventhouse capturing high-volume operational telemetry. A warning node calls out the blast-radius cost of merging bronze and silver into one lakehouse.
svg.text: Investment Analytics Medallion on Microsoft Fabric

Blast-radius risk of merged bronze/silver — One shared Tables namespace means bronze and silver no longer have item-level isolation.3 ingestion paths → one lakehouse (bronze+silver) → dbt-built Warehouse gold → Direct Lake
MAIN DATA FLOW — LEFT TO RIGHT
single Fabric item — bronze and silver are folders/schemas inside it, not separate lakehouses
mirrored tables land here via a
Apache Airflow job (in Data Factory) triggers dbt run → builds/tests wh_gold models

eh_ops Eventhouse (operational telemetry) — High-volume, per-event telemetry from ingestion functions lands in an Eventhouse, not the control-plane database.SIDE RAILS — TELEMETRY & OPERATIONAL METADATA (separate lanes from the analytics data path above)
so ops dashboards can join run
reads control tables · writes run audit + telemetry
LEGEND — what handles each hop, and why

Data Factory Copy (custodian files) — A metadata-driven pipeline copies custodian/administrator files into bronze.Data Factory Copy activity = flat-file ingestion, metadata-driven from sqldb_meta control tables (entity list, watermark, schedule)

Mirroring (portfolio/transactions DB) — The operational portfolio/transactions database replicates continuously into OneLake, no pipeline required.Mirroring = continuous, near-real-time replica of the operational DB straight into OneLake Delta — no pipeline authored or run

text.aria-label: Data Factory API pulls (market data, risk engine)

svg.text: Data Factory API pulls (market data, risk engine) — A second metadata-driven pipeline polls market-data and risk-engine REST APIs on a schedule.Data Factory REST/API pipeline = scheduled pulls from market data / risk engine HTTP endpoints, same control-table pattern

Lakehouse (bronze + silver schemas) — One lakehouse holds both bronze and silver as schemas, all files and the mirrored replica landing here.lh_analytics = ONE lakehouse hosting both bronze (raw append-only Delta, per-source folders) and silver (PySpark-conformed) zones

dbt-built warehouse gold (Airflow orchestrated) — dbt, run by Airflow inside Data Factory, reads silver and builds a star schema in the warehouse.wh_gold = Fabric Warehouse star schema built by the dbt-fabric adapter, orchestrated by an Apache Airflow job inside Data Factory

Power BI via Direct Lake — Power BI reads wh_gold's Delta tables straight from OneLake with no import refresh.Direct Lake / Power BI = reads wh_gold Delta straight from OneLake — no import model, no refresh lag for analysts

sqldb_meta control plane — A Fabric SQL database records every pipeline and dbt run for cross-path audit.eh_ops (Eventhouse/KQL) = high-volume granular telemetry from Azure Functions; sqldb_meta = control tables + run-level audit (OLTP)
Dashed border = external Azure service (Azure Functions), outside the Fabric workspace boundary
